verdict.rationale: The installer writes skills into the repo as ordinary, editable files you own (docs-24, docs-47, docs-2). A hands-on probe showed a single `tdd` skill installed selectively to ./.claude/skills/tdd/ with its SKILL.md readable afterward (probe-rt-1). Each skill's SKILL.md is also published in the open repo, so it can be read before installing (docs-5, docs-6, docs-9), and a community member reports learning from reading the skills (comm-1). missing for 10: a documented command to list or preview a skill's full file contents (including any scripts) before installing, and any explicit file manifest. The plugin route installs a managed read-only bundle, and its post-install file visibility is undocumented (docs-41).
